title: Hibou Repository Config
description: Repository-scoped Hibou configuration for branch-aware weakness quality gates.

version.description: Schema version for the Hibou repository configuration file.

quality_gates.description: Optional branch-aware quality gate rules. The most specific matching branch pattern wins.

coverage.description: Optional repository-wide coverage settings such as exclude patterns.

upload.description: Optional upload behavior configuration for snapshot grouping.

branches.description: One or more exact branch names or glob patterns such as release/*.

items.description: An exact branch name or a path.Match-compatible glob pattern.

weaknesses.description: Optional weakness gate thresholds for matching branches. If omitted, Hibou falls back to platform-managed weakness gates.

coverage.description: Optional coverage gate thresholds for matching branches.

min_coverage.description: Absolute minimum total line coverage percentage allowed for matching branches.

grace.description: Allowed total coverage regression percentage versus the target branch before the gate fails. Defaults to 0.

diff_minimum.description: Minimum line coverage percentage required on changed lines only.

coverageThresholds.description: Thresholds for coverage quality gates on matching branches.

exclude.description: Glob patterns for files excluded from coverage metrics.

window.description: Safety-net timeout that force-closes a snapshot if neither --complete nor --expect triggers completion (e.g., a parallel job crashed). Go time.Duration format such as 10m or 1h.

enabled.description: Whether weakness gating is enabled for matching branches. Defaults to true. Set to false to disable weakness gating and override platform-managed weakness gates.

max_critical.description: Maximum number of new critical-severity findings allowed. Omit for no limit.

max_high.description: Maximum number of new high-severity findings allowed. Omit for no limit.

max_medium.description: Maximum number of new medium-severity findings allowed. Omit for no limit.

weaknessThresholds.description: Thresholds for weakness findings on matching branches.
